name: Gasthof Stuibenfall
kurzbeschreibung:
**Inn Stuibenfall** in **Umhausen** – a cozy alpine retreat nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal** Valley. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this charming guesthouse invites you to unwind in a rustic yet refined setting.

Savor hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Gröstl**, and fresh mountain trout, all crafted with local ingredients. After a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning **Karwendel** or **Zillertaler Alpen**, warm up by the crackling fireplace with a glass of **Tiroler** wine or a frothy **Schnaps**.

The **Stuibenfall** offers comfortable rooms with mountain views, a tranquil garden, and easy access to the **Zillertal Arena** ski slopes. Whether you're seeking adventure or relaxation, this hidden gem promises an authentic taste of **Tirol**.
